name: meta_assets_search
description: Search for existing 3D models in Meta's asset library using text descriptions. Returns download URLs for FBX and GLB files along with preview images. This tool searches Meta's curated collection of 3D models.

number_of_models.description: Number of models to return from search results (default: 1, max: 10)

prompt.description: Text description of the 3D model to search for (e.g., 'red car', 'fantasy sword', 'office chair')
